messages:
Maya: deploy-bot flagged inconsistent tenant pin routing during the v2 canary. Some requests losing X-API-Version header. Need tie-break decision fast.

deploy-bot: Canary started for api.v2 @5%. Pin snapshot: v1=18, v2=6, unpinned=11. Header-drop events: 9 in last 10m. /deploybot/logs/1778

Tyler: If headers are dropped, pinned tenants might be routed by feature-flag instead. Which tenants are enterprise?

Zach: Two large customers affected: delta-inc and epsilon-llc. They are ~0.5% qps but high SLA.

Priya: Release notes need a line: header normalization and pin precedence policy. Support blurb queued.

Maya: Options: (1) keep header-preferred, (2) prefer tenant pin (safe), (3) pause. My vote: prefer tenant pin to avoid surprises.

ops_lead: We can flip routing.pin_tiebreak to "prefer_pin" now. It takes <1m but will freeze auto-scaler actions for 30m. Confirm?

Tyler: Confirm. We'll run a quick 10m pinned bake for delta-inc.

ops_lead: Running: `deploybot config set routing.pin_tiebreak prefer_pin` -> OK. Pinning delta-inc -> success.

Zach: Telemetry 6m: delta-inc p95 +10ms, no error increase. Epsilon looks stable too.

Priya: Posted support note to #support and updated internal KB link /kb/v2-pin-behavior.

Maya: Proceeding with canary at 5% under prefer_pin for 30m hold. Guardrails: rollback if pinned-tenant 3m error delta >0.75% OR global 5xx >1%.

deploy-bot: Checkpoint +15m: no breaches. Continuing.

Maya: Decision logged: prefer_pin engaged, support/docs updated, canary hold 30m. Revert command: `deploybot config set routing.pin_tiebreak header_preferred` if requested. Closing thread unless alerts trigger."
